title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-834)
description: As of August 19, 2026, Cisco is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
BroadWorks Application Delivery Platform
	Prior to RI.2026.07

BroadWorks Application Server
	Prior to RI.2026.07

BroadWorks Profile Server
	Prior to RI.2026.07

BroadWorks Xtended Services Platform
	Prior to RI.2026.07

Cisco Crosswork Data Gateway
	Prior to 7.2.1-SP

Cisco Crosswork Network Controller
	Prior to 7.2.1-SP

Cisco Secure Workload
	Version 3.10 prior to 3.10.9.1
Version 4.0 prior to 4.0.4.16
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
